# name: The houses of trial; the fathers die; the calabash tree
# title: Are v nabe ri Queꜫuma Ha
# fols: fols. 14v–15v
Are v nabe ri Queꜫuma Ha, vtuquel queꜫum vpam. Vcab chicut Xuxulim Ha vbi; ꜩaꜩ chi teu vpam, zac xuruxuh, cac caracoh chi xurulah teu choc vloc chupam.

Rox chicut Balami Ha vbi, vtuquel balam ꜭo chupan; que quichouic, que buchuvic chi matat, que chi qui tit; que e ꜩapim balam pa ha.

Ꜩoꜩi Ha vbi vcah vtihobal; vtuquel ꜩoꜩ vpam chi ha, que ꜩiꜩotic, que ꜩitilahic, que ropop pa ha, e ꜩapin ꜩoꜩ, mahabi que el vi.

Roo chicut Chaim Ha vbi, vtuquel chaꜫol chupam, zac leloh re chi cha, chi ꜩininic, chi yohohic chiri pa ha.

Que nabec vtihobal Xibalba. Ma cu xe oc ri Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu chupam; xa vbixic apon oc vtihobal ha.

Ta xe oc cu apan oc Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu chuvach Huncame, Vvcub Came: “Apa ꜭo vi ri nu zic? Aon ꜭo vi ri nu chah xhe yaoc chivech?” Xquec xvꜭhax cut. “Xca quizo, at ahau.”

“Vꜩ bala. Vacamic bala xquiz iꜫih. Quix camic, xqui zachic, xqui ca cup puch. Varal xchi vevah vi ivach. Quix puzic,” xꜭha Huncame, Vvcub Came.

Ta xe puz cut, xe muc cut chi Pucbal Chah vbi; xe muc vi. Xcat vholom ri Hunhunahpu; xa vnimal xmuquic ruꜭ ri vchac.

“Chi ya ri vholom xol che ri tiquil pa be,” xꜭha cut Huncame, Vvcub Came. Ta xbe cu yaoc vholom xol che. Ta xvachin curi che; mahabi vvach maha choco ri vholom ri Hunhunahpu chuxol che. Are curi zima cohcha chire vacamic “vholom Hunhunahpu” chuꜭhaxic.

Ta xumaihah cut Huncame, Vvcub Came vvach ri che; humah colocac vvach. Ma cu calah ꜭo chi vi ri vholom Hunhunahpu; xa hunam chic vvach ruꜭ vvach zima. Cu rilo ronohel Xibalba ta chul qui caiih.

Nim vꜭoheic ri che xux chi qui ꜭux, rumal huzu xubanic, ta xoc vholom Hunhunahpu chuxol. Xeꜭha curi Xibalba chi quibil quib: “Ma co ma chupuvic ri vvach; ma co naipu ma oc apan oc chuxe che,” xeꜭha; xqui catah quib, xqui quil quib Xibalba conohel.

Ma cu calah chi ri vholom Hunhunahpu; xa hunamatal chic ruc vvach che, ri zima vbi xuxic. Nim cut vꜩihoxic xuta hun capoh. Va cute xchi ca biyh roponic.
